number.description: An uninterpreted element standing in for a positive integer. VE has no numeric sort; nothing here forces this domain to be the integers, to be infinite, or to be ordered.

prime.description: Uninterpreted unary symbol intended to mean 'is prime'. VE cannot state the definition, which quantifies over factorisations and needs a ternary multiplication relation.

unit.description: Uninterpreted unary symbol intended to mean 'equals 1'.

divides.description: Uninterpreted binary symbol intended to mean 'the first divides the second'.

associate.description: Uninterpreted binary symbol intended to mean 'the two numbers are equal up to units'.

lt.description: Uninterpreted binary symbol intended to mean strict numeric order.
